description: Find Kolada KPI (indicator) ids by title substring (Swedish). Searches ~5,000 indicators covering economy, schools, health, demographics, and personnel. Returns id, title, description, operating_area, and is_divided_by_gender. Use the returned id with get_data.

title.description: Substring of the indicator title (Swedish), e.g. "arbetslös" or "betyg".
